commitResults.messageBody: Add class 'ChatList' to store list items

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for mark and unmark
commitResults.messageBody:
Create Class 'ListItem' to store list item text and mark/unmark status.
Update Class 'ChatList' to store ListItems.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for todo, deadline, event
commitResults.messageBody:
Added child classes "TodoItem", "DeadlineItem", "EventItem" of
"ListItem".
All ListItems now also print an icon corresponding to what
sort of item it is.

*Misc: Change the way messages are printed. They are now printed in the
switch statement, making things easier to read.
